newsitem.title: CHINA: China Tazhong 4 field producing 5,000 T oil a day.
newsitem.headline: China Tazhong 4 field producing 5,000 T oil a day.

text.p: Production of crude oil from the Tazhong 4 oil field in China's northwestern Xinjiang region has reached 5,000 tonnes a day, the Xinhua news agency said.

Tazhong 4, which was discovered in the heart of the Taklimakan Desert in 1992, covers a total oil-bearing area of 35.7 square km and crude oil was being piped to the city of Korla 500 km away, the agency said.
It gave no comparative figures for production, but state newspapers reported in July last year that Tazhong 4 output had reached 3,000 tonnes.
Tazhong 4 was the fifth oilfield to be developed in Xinjiang's Tarim Basin and together with the other four produced 4.4 million tonnes of crude oil a year, Xinhua said but gave no details.
